answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake that decays only after a long probation, so a sparrow of fake identities cannot flood the market cheaply: each new account must post a bond and earn a delta of verified work before it can transact at full limits. A sable ledger records stake history, and any identity caught cloning another loses its bond and its history. Sybils then face a real cost per identity: capital locked, time spent, and forfeiture on detection, instead of free duplication.
